subject: Literature
title: The Edda and Snorri's Preservation
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Edda and Snorri's Preservation.

hook.text: Almost everything we know about Norse mythology comes from one Icelandic politician writing in the 1220s.

buildup.text: Snorri Sturluson compiled the Prose Edda to preserve the old stories that were fading under Christianity.

discovery.text: The older Poetic Edda was discovered later, containing the original poems Snorri had paraphrased in prose.

twist.text: Snorri was eventually assassinated in a political dispute, but his literary work survived him by centuries.

climax.text: Without Snorri, most Norse mythology would have been permanently lost to Christianization.

punchline.text: One murdered politician saved an entire mythology.

quiz.question: Why is Snorri Sturluson important to Norse mythology?
options: He invented all the Norse myths himself
He compiled the Prose Edda, preserving stories fading under Christianity
He was a Viking warrior who discovered Valhalla
